{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Cronus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Cronus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Swift Sneak}} II and {{MCW|Soul Speed}} II. It is crafted from four {{MCW|Sculk|sculk}}, three {{MCW|Echo Shard|echo shards}} and an iron hoe. Swift Sneak and Soul Speed are otherwise found only in [[Ancient City|ancient city]] chests and [[Bastion Remnant|bastions]] or by {{MCW|Bartering|bartering}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/swift_sneak_soul_speed.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Cronus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Cronus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Swift Sneak applies to leggings and Soul Speed to boots.

== Trivia ==
* Cronus is the Titan of Greek mythology who was later identified with time, and he is often shown with a sickle, represented here by the hoe.
